mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) debit, IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) credit FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{params.bookId} and bv.year_period >= #{params.startPeriod} and bv.year_period <= #{params.endPeriod} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{subjectId} and book_id = #{params.bookId}) ,'%')
